title: Five Quarters of the Orange by Joanne Harris
description:
This week Novels & Nibbles is set in the Loire Valley of France, so hold on for some taste bud tantalizing. Framboise Dartigen returns to the village where she grew up, and quietly opens a creperie on the farm she inherited from her mother. At the heart of the story, her mother’s treasured recipe album is part cookbook, part diary. Its pages are filled with cryptic notes, memories, clues to the past, and always there are the oranges. Their fragrance winds through the novel as something delicious, dangerous, and tied deeply to memory. 

Delicate house-made crepes filled luxuriously with a smooth blend of cream cheese and  FROG Jam, an acronym for figs (freshly picked from our fig tree right outside the front door), Raspberries, Oranges, and Ginger. Our house creation is bursting with flavor, folded with French finesse, finished with a vibrant raspberry coulis, a whisper of powdered sugar, and a scattering of toasted slivered almonds for a gentle crunch.

A refreshing Must-Try. C’est si bon.
